operation_edge.reason: PAIR represents the reported publisher and rosbridge subscription on the same topic. This is an attempted application-level connection, not a successful DDS match or delivery. The reproduction explicitly subscribes to the publisher topic, and the log identifies /my_topic.
operation_edge.quote: Run `rosbridge_server` and attempt to subscribe to that topic using a rosbridge client library (roslibpy, roslibjs). The subscriber should not receive any data.

notes: No permission-grant set is encoded as absent: producer grants are unknown and consumer grants are present. The absent perm_requires state is not an absent grant set and is not a triggering value. Dependency checked in rmw/qos_profiles.h rather than relying on the provenance description naming types.h.
